components.label: Base and mounting bracket
components.purpose: Dual moonflower effect on a base with a hanging bracket, 287 × 281 × 182 mm (L × W × H) and 3.2 kg. Fits the CHS-40 gear bag.
components.limits: Envelope is published; pod and bracket shapes are approximate.

components.label: Left rotating pod
components.purpose: One of two LED-filled pods that rotate separately, together or against each other, throwing 63° of RGB beams.

components.label: Right rotating pod
components.purpose: Second pod; the two share 112 LEDs (32 red, 48 green, 32 blue at 0.25 W each, 100,000 h).

components.label: Power input cable and fuse
components.purpose: Fixed power cable, 120/230 V switchable, 16 W / 0.2 A at 120 V, with a replaceable fuse beside it.

components.label: Power link outlet (Edison)
components.purpose: Edison outlet next to the power cable for daisy-chaining up to 36 units at 120 V or 70 at 230 V.

components.label: Sound-active control
components.purpose: Standalone sound-active mode is the only operating mode; no DMX. Programs follow the music.
